_comment: Dev only, never shipped. Copied into the dev install by DeployDev.ps1 -WithSelfTest (removed by any deploy without it). Turns on the 1.6 environment self-test: after delaySeconds of unpaused play following a save load or a new game, SpellLearning.log gets one [selftest-1.6] line per check (docs/ENVIRONMENT.md, Self-test). autoScan: the scan at game start runs at the main menu whatever its record says and logs 'AutoScan SELFTEST:' lines (RUN, TREE, HITCH, SAME, DROP; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, Scan at game start); sliceMs is one step's game thread time, budgetMs how much longer than the main menu's own the longest frame may be.
